character.description: Original GD-01 GUARD SD space mecha; preserve the accepted canonical base identity exactly.

idle.action: extremely subtle mechanical idle: keep the exact same stance, silhouette, weapon position and foot baseline in all frames; only alternate a one logical-pixel visor sensor blink and a one logical-pixel backpack vent pulse; no limb movement and no body-size change

move.action: cyclic forward-thrust flight using the exact 32x32 anchor pixel density: slight forward lean, compact backpack compression and extension, subtle leg tuck and armor inertia, then exact seamless return to the first pose; fixed identity and no detached flame or effects

fire.action: raise compact rifle, fire recoil pose without muzzle effect, settle, return to idle

melee.action: short mechanical energy-saber melee sequence: brace, draw a short solid cyan-white pixel blade physically attached to the right hand, windup, forward slash, recovery, return to idle; the blade is part of the silhouette, never detached, with no glow or motion trail; do not use the rifle as the melee weapon
